objective: Qualify estimation of normalized timelike separation from a marked finite order under explicit known 1+1-dimensional flat sampling assumptions; then describe transfer to density/height-matched jittered grids.

target.name: theta
target.definition: tau(p,q)/T = sqrt((u_q-u_p)*(v_q-v_p)) for dimensionless null coordinates in (0,1)^2; physical t=T*(u+v)/2, x=T*(u-v)/2, c=1.
target.scale: T is a declared external unit, never inferred from the order.
target.auxiliary: a=theta^2; interval spacetime-volume fraction equals a.

allowed_predictor_inputs: declared model d=2 and domain scale convention
forbidden_predictor_inputs: RNG key or draw ID as numeric features

sampling.endpoints: Before background generation, draw independent uniform p,q in (0,1)^2 and reject only endpoint draws until u_p<u_q and v_p<v_q. Do not sort coordinates independently, or choose endpoints after inspecting an order. Each accepted endpoint pair gets exactly one independently generated background.
sampling.uniform: m independent uniform points in the same unit square.
sampling.jittered_grid: s=2*sqrt(m); choose m distinct sites uniformly without replacement from s*s sites, and independently jitter each coordinate: (integer_index+0.5+0.4*(U-0.5))/s. Both endpoints follow the same continuous law as uniform. This is a distribution-shift stress control, not a Poisson sprinkling.
sampling.precision: Use the pinned Stream.unit() midpoint 52-bit rule. Draw endpoint coordinates in order u_p,v_p,u_q,v_q; reject endpoint attempts only until both strict inequalities hold, with a hard cap of 10000 attempts per draw. Then generate background. C_ij=1 iff i!=j and u_i<=u_j and v_i<=v_j. Coordinate ties are retained and logged; duplicate full coordinate pairs cause INCONCLUSIVE, never silent redraw. Record endpoint attempts and all tie counts. These finite-precision laws approximate the continuum model used in the proof.
sampling.splits: Separate Stream('lorentz-proper-time-v1',family,m,split,draw) keys with split calibration/test. One marked pair per independently drawn order; no subinterval pseudoreplication.
sampling.exclusions: No rejection by K, local chain length, theta, prediction error, R or H in the unselected primary cohort. No pool extension.
sampling.rng_order: For uniform backgrounds draw u then v for each of m nodes. For jittered_grid use Stream.shuffle(range(s*s))[:m]; site coordinates (site//s,site%s), draw u-jitter then v-jitter for each selected site. Endpoint and background draws use the same per-order stream sequentially.

methods.K: Count strict interval interior {z:p<z<q}; endpoints excluded.
methods.ell: Height of the strict interior in vertices; ell=0 if K=0. Closed-interval height=ell+2; longest endpoint-to-endpoint chain in edges=ell+1.
methods.L: theta_hat=min(1,ell/(2*sqrt(m))); raw value also archived. Asymptotic m_2=2 motivates this descriptive comparator; no finite-sample unbiasedness claim.
methods.C0: theta_hat=64/225, the analytic unconditional mean theta for the specified endpoint law.
methods.D: At each m separately fit theta by OLS on calibration uniform orders, columns [1,r,h,r*r,r*h,h*h], r=R/binomial(N,2), h=H/N. Moore-Penrose SVD inverse with relative cutoff 1e-12; no feature tuning or regularization search; clip predictions to [0,1]. Archive raw predictions, coefficients, singular values and effective rank. Same fitted model is applied to both test families.
methods.P123: Not evaluated. Conditional on K, the inner order alone is ancillary for theta in the unselected uniform model. No universal claim for full orders or matched subsets.

matched_transfer.role: Secondary descriptive stress check only; does not replace primary uniform cohort.
matched_transfer.R: all strict relations of full marked order
matched_transfer.H: global height in vertices including marked endpoints
matched_transfer.selection: For each m, group uniform/test and jittered_grid/test by exact (R,H). Sort IDs by draw, pair kth members without replacement, sort pairs by SHA256 of compact JSON [namespace,'match',m,uniform_id,jittered_id], take first 128 pairs. No K, ell, coordinates, target or predictions enter matching.
matched_transfer.insufficient: INSUFFICIENT_COMMON_SUPPORT; record full ledger, no matched performance summary. No tolerance relaxation.
matched_transfer.estimand: Finite selected common-support subset. Conditional binomial formulas from the unselected uniform model do not assert unbiasedness or coverage after matching.

gates: Both 95% whole-order paired bootstrap upper bounds for MSE(V)-MSE(D) and MSE(V)-MSE(C0) are strictly below zero.
primary.decision: All gates and integrity checks pass: QUALIFIED_IN_DECLARED_MODEL. Otherwise NO_QUALIFICATION_DEMONSTRATED; execution/coverage failures: INCONCLUSIVE. This is an intersection of required gates, not selection of the better p-value. Thresholds are engineering qualification choices, not physical constants or a power guarantee.

bootstrap.unit: independent marked order, one endpoint pair each
bootstrap.method: percentile interval using linear quantiles; same resample indices for all methods; calibration fixed; Stream('lorentz-proper-time-v1','bootstrap',family,m)

evaluation.secondary: Per size/family/method: RMSE, MAE, signed bias and complete individual errors; squared-time a_hat bias and MSE; zero-K frequency. Paired order bootstrap for unselected cohorts; whole matched-pair bootstrap for matched cohorts. Match-induced dependence between cohorts is not extra independent evidence. L comparisons and all transfer cells descriptive.
evaluation.analytic_checks: Before matching: K conditional on endpoints is Binomial(m,a); E[K/m]=a, Var[K/m]=a*(1-a)/m. For this endpoint law E[a]=1/9, E[a^2]=1/36, hence unconditional MSE(a_hat)=1/(12*m). sqrt(K/m) is downward biased, so never call theta_hat unbiased.
evaluation.reporting: Primary results remain primary even if negative; all sizes, rejected endpoint attempts, cohorts and failed matching cells reported. No target-bin filtering, relative error threshold near theta=0, or post-test estimator changes.

pre_run_gate: Implement generator, estimator interface, separate coordinate oracle, independent interval/longest-chain checks and declared bootstrap
Validate only small deterministic toys before target data
Publish computational source hashes and immutable source commit
Only then generate new target samples
implementation_tests: K and ell on empty, chain and antichain intervals
binomial first/second moments by finite exact sums
rational boost u->2u,v->v/2 and common coordinate dilation with scaled T
forbidden-field rejection and test-label/coordinate leakage tests
independent source replay and full output coverage

publication.scope: Design and deterministic analytical examples only. Subsequent source freeze must precede any target sample. Implementation-driven amendments require a new public design version before generation.

limits: Known flat d=2 model and sampling law; no dimension inference
Absolute time scale not identifiable from unweighted finite order alone
Exact finite theta not identifiable even with declared T
Ancillarity statement is restricted to unselected uniform interval interiors conditioned on K
Full-order outside information, curvature, nonuniform sampling and selected subsets lie outside that argument
No continuum-limit proof, manifold certificate, new algorithm or physical validation

resources.failure: INCONCLUSIVE with preserved logs; no silent partial cohort.

archive: every RNG key and endpoint rejection count
coordinates, marks and full relation or lossless relation rows for every order
primary and secondary metrics, bootstrap settings and integrity results
